main_text.p: regeneransiin sacra vero Cœna, vt nos iam in Baptismo ablutos,& ipsi insitos ac regenerator sui ipsius alimonia spiritualiter pascens, Sacramentalibus peculiaribus signis repræsentetur.Nam quo iure istud Baptismo detraxerimus, quû Christus ipse, in simplici quoque verbo suo carne suam edi, & sanguinem suum bibi, apertissimè testetur: & quidem verbis non minus expressis, de fide ex verbi simplicis auditu differes, quàm quû sacrâ illâ Cœnam institueret,locutus? Quid igitur (inquiunt) amplius in sacra Domini Cœna accipimus? Respondeo ipsis Christi verbis fretus, vtrobique Christi carnem veram manducari, & verum sanguinem bibi, & quidem vno & eodem modo, spiritualiter nimirum per fidem, quam quisquis veram habet, Totum Christum, & Totû Christi est amplexus, vt qui nobis nonnisi totus sit saluificus.Sed vt caducam hanc vitam, primùm nascendo, deinde paulatim ab adolescentia ad virilem ætatem progrediendo,adhibitis cuique ætati cómodis cibis, vtiimus: ita nos diuini verbi quasi femine, ad vitam spiritualem, in Ecclesiæ vtero primùm ferì, cuius ortus peculiare sigillum est Baptismus: postea sensim,eiusdem verbi prædicati, & Christum nobis per fidem recipiendum prębentis,meditatione quotidiana, in ea vita foueri, & eius alimoniæ vi, adhibito huius nostræ cum Christo, in dies arctius & efficacius sefe nobis adiungente, communionis Sacramento, adolescere

page.notes: Page is mostly clear. Several words are doubtful at the scan's low resolution and fold: "fcere" at the end is shown as "fcere" on its own line (catchword-like continuation, probably "adolescere" split across lines; the word is copied as printed on the last line, so the paragraph ends with "adolescere"). Uncertain readings where the scan is faded or damaged: "regeneransiin" (printed as "regenerans:in"), "sanguinem", "Totû" and "saluificus" have been read with reasonable but not complete confidence. Stains and show-through on the left and right edges were ignored.
